caption: The drawing features two detailed renderings of a ceramic vessel, both set inside separate rectangular borders drawn on a cream-colored background. The main vessel, centrally positioned and occupying most of the image, is rounded with a narrow base that expands into a wide midsection before tapering slightly at the lip. The vessel is rendered in muted green and olive tones with highlights and shadows indicating a glossy, reflective surface. Vertical ridges and bands encircle its body, and a single ornate handle, shaped in a curved, scroll-like design, is visible on one side. Above and to the right of the main vessel, there is a smaller inset drawing of the same vessel shown from a slightly higher angle and with both handles visible; this smaller rendering also features the same ridged surface details and greenish color with light reflections. Both vessels are contained in thin, hand-drawn rectangular boxes, framing them separately, and the artist’s signature, “W.A. Shorttuff,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
